payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how audio and text sequences are combined in the RNN model.

claims.text: The model uses dual recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to independently encode audio and text data, then combines these encodings using a feed-forward neural network to predict emotion classes.

The audio-RNN encodes MFCC features from audio signals, while the text-RNN encodes word sequences from transcripts, and their final hidden states are concatenated to form a comprehensive representation.
An attention mechanism is applied to focus on specific parts of the text transcript that are emotionally significant, conditioning on the audio information.
The attention-application vector generated from the text-RNN is concatenated with the audio-RNN's final encoding vector to predict the emotion class.
